transcript.text:
Thank you all for your thorough reports. Let me record what I've heard and the required plan changes before I make my final decision.

From Ms. Patel, peer-mediation advisor: The roster and training status report shows that ten of the twelve proposed mediators — M1, M2, M3, M5, M6, M7, M8, M10, M11, and M12 — have completed the required mediation practicum. Two mediators, M4 and M9, have not yet completed it. Required plan change: M4 and M9 must be removed from the active mediator roster until they complete the practicum.

From Mr. Lewis, counselor: The referral-screening report identifies active no-contact orders involving two students, Nia and Omar. Required plan change: the operating plan must include a screening rule excluding any referral involving Nia or Omar from peer mediation.

From Dr. Romero, school psychologist: The safety and supervision report requires two changes. First, the referral scope must be limited to minor peer conflicts only — not moderate conflicts as the current draft proposes. Second, every mediation session must have two adult supervisors, not one as the current draft specifies.

So the updated operating plan would be: ten approved mediators (M1, M2, M3, M5, M6, M7, M8, M10, M11, M12), mediation sessions on Mondays and Wednesdays during lunch, referrals limited to minor peer conflicts only, Nia and Omar excluded from any referrals, and two adult supervisors per session.

Unless anyone has additional concerns, I'm prepared to issue my final approval decision on this updated plan.
